en-US.description: Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.
en-US.longDescription: Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
en-US.name: Lexora Buddy
en-US.releaseNotes:
The Local Models plugin is here—from discovery and downloads to running models on your own computer. This is the headline feature of 0.20.0: search Hugging Face, import existing model files, and bring local chat, image understanding, speech transcription, read-aloud, image generation, and OCR into your everyday tasks.
We’ve also refined task management and daily interactions. Task history now supports pagination and global search, companions can have their own reasoning-effort settings, and installed plugins have a more direct update entry point. This release also fixes issues with conversation reading, text pasting, system speech, and multi-companion collaboration.

zh-CN.description: 具备插件、内置浏览器、工作区文件与本地模型支持的桌面 AI Agent。
zh-CN.longDescription: Lexora 是在真实桌面实践中自我演化的个人 AI Agent。它不局限于代码助手的角色，也能陪你整理资料、打磨作品、安排日常。你说出目标，它持续推进，让文字成为工作、创作与生活的起点。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
“本地模型”插件来了——从发现、下载到运行，让模型直接在你的电脑上工作。 这是 0.20.0 最重要的更新：你可以在 Lexora 中搜索 Hugging Face 模型、导入已有模型文件，并将本地对话、图像理解、语音转写、朗读、图像生成和文字识别接入日常任务，让本机算力成为伙伴的新选择。
同时，我们继续打磨任务管理与使用体验：历史任务支持分页加载和全局搜索，伙伴可以单独设置推理强度，已安装插件有了更直接的更新入口。对话阅读、文本粘贴、系统朗读和多伙伴协作中的一些问题，也在这个版本中得到修复。
